title: PicardExternalCoefficientsAffineCechTerms
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $F,G$ quasi-coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $I$ be finite, $U:I\to\operatorname{Opens}(X)$ a family whose intersections $\bigcap_l U_{y(l)}$ are affine for every $n\geq0$ and $y:\operatorname{Fin}(n+1)\to I$, and $V$ an affine open of $Y$. No covering condition is imposed. Put $Z=X\times_kY$, $W=\operatorname{pr}_2^{-1}V$, $E=(\operatorname{pr}_1^*F\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G)|_W$ [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], and $U'_i=W.\iota^{-1}(\operatorname{pr}_1^{-1}U_i)$. Let $L$ be the native Cech complex of $E$ on $U'$, with its scalar action forgotten [def-sc-module-cech-comparison], and let $D$ be the Cech complex of $F$ on $U$ with scalars restricted from $\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ to $k$, tensoring each term with $N=\Gamma(V,G|_V)$, then forgetting scalars. There exist additive-group isomorphisms $e_n:D^n\cong L^n$ for every $n$. They have the following normalization. For $a$ in the degree $n$ restricted Cech module, $t\in N$, and a tuple $y$, the $y$ coordinate of $e_n(a\otimes t)$ is the tensor section of the pullback-unit image of the $y$ coordinate of $a$ and the pullback-unit image of $t$, each restricted to the intersection $\bigcap_l U'_{y(l)}$. Restriction sections are identified with sections on their image under $W.\iota$; $t$ is identified with $G(V)$ under the restriction-section isomorphism. No differential or cohomology compatibility is asserted.

proof.text: Put Z=X times_Spec(k) Y, W=pr2 inverse V and E=(pr1^*F tensor pr2^*G)|W. The cover family on W is U_i'=W.ι inverse(pr1 inverse U_i). An intersection is U_intersection times V; both factors are affine. The open-immersion pullback/restriction comparison, its unit equation and pullback composition identify the restricted external coefficients with the external coefficients for F restricted to the intersection and G restricted to V.

Apply the proved externalGlobalSectionsTensor_bijective_of_isAffine to F restricted to the affine intersection and G restricted to V. The normalized open-immersion and pullback-composition comparisons of the preceding step transport this canonical map to the original restricted pullback-unit sections followed by tmulSection. Thus the chart comparison is an additive-group isomorphism with precisely the required pure-tensor formula; the affine tensor algebra calculation is reused, not reproved.

For each degree n the tuple set Fin(n+1) to I is finite. Use Mathlib TensorProduct.piRight, conjugated by tensor commutativity, to identify (product M_y) tensor N with product (M_y tensor N). Its pure-tensor formula is coordinatewise tensoring. Compose with the chart comparisons and native Cech product-coordinate equivalences to obtain the asserted normalization. Empty tuple sets, empty intersections, empty V and zero coefficients obey the same formulas. No differential assertion is made.

theorem picardAffineCech_normalized_terms [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    [Finite ι]
    (hU : ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ι), IsAffineOpen (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    ∃ e : ∀ n, (picardAffineCechRight f g F G U V).X n ≅
      (picardAffineCechLeft f g F G U V).X n,
      PicardAffineCechNormalized f g F G U V e
